annotation_description: Bottomed their only Mountain from a hand that needs red mana for every spell. With only Soulstone Sanctuary (colorless mana) remaining as a land, they cannot cast any spell in their hand - Burnout Bashtronaut needs R, Shock needs R, Razorkin Needlehead needs RR. They're essentially starting the game with 0 castable cards until they draw a Mountain.

Playing Steam Vents on turn 1 instead of Rockface Village means either paying 2 life unnecessarily to cast Hired Claw, or having the land enter tapped and missing the turn 1 Hired Claw play. Rockface Village enters untapped for free and can tap for {R} to cast creature spells like Hired Claw.

With 2 mana available (Steam Vents untapped + Rockface Village, though Rockface Village can only add R for creatures), the player could cast a second Hired Claw for just {R} to develop the board further. Having two Hired Claws means the attack trigger deals 2 damage instead of 1 when attacking with Lizards, accelerating the clock significantly. Passing with mana unused on turn 2 when there's a cheap creature to deploy is wasteful tempo.

Failed to activate Hired Claw's +1/+1 counter ability when the condition was met (opponent lost life this turn, going to 19). Had the mana available (Steam Vents + Rockface Village for {1}{R}) and no better use for the mana with an empty opposing board.

Missed the opportunity to activate Hired Claw's pump ability ({1}{R}: Put a +1/+1 counter) during combat. The opponent already lost 1 life from Hired Claw's attack trigger, enabling the ability. A permanent +1/+1 counter making it a 2/3 would be significant value for an aggressive deck, especially since the mana would otherwise go unused this turn.

Hired Claw's ability says '{1}{R}: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. Activate only if an opponent lost life this turn and only once each turn.' The opponent has lost life this turn (went from 19 to 18 from Hired Claw's trigger damage), so this ability is now active. With Rockface Village and Steam Vents available (providing {R} and another mana), the player could have activated Hired Claw's ability to put a +1/+1 counter on it, making it a 2/3. This is a free permanent buff that was missed.

Paid 2 life for Hallowed Fountain to enter untapped when Floodfarm Verge would have accomplished the same thing for free. Both lands enable casting Llanowar Elves this turn (using Starting Town for G). Against an aggressive deck with two Hired Claws, 2 life matters. Floodfarm Verge now and Hallowed Fountain later (when it might need to enter untapped for a specific play) is strictly better sequencing.

The Hired Claws have already attacked and dealt their trigger damage, and the opponent is at 15 life (meaning an opponent has lost life this turn). Both Hired Claws have the activated ability '{1}{R}: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. Activate only if an opponent lost life this turn and only once each turn.' The opponent has an empty board with no blockers, so the Hired Claws are attacking unblocked. Pumping them before damage resolves would deal extra damage. With 3 untapped lands (Steam Vents, Rockface Village, Mountain), they could activate at least one Hired Claw's ability to put a +1/+1 counter on it, making it a 2/3 that deals 2 damage instead of 1. They might even be able to activate both if they have enough mana (each costs {1}{R}, so they'd need 4 mana total but only have 3 lands). They could activate one for sure, dealing 1 extra damage.

After attacking with both Hired Claws and dealing combat damage, the opponent lost life this turn. Hired Claw's activated ability '{1}{R}: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. Activate only if an opponent lost life this turn and only once each turn' could be activated on one of the Hired Claws. With a Mountain and Rockface Village available (assuming at least one is untapped), spending {1}{R} to put a +1/+1 counter on a Hired Claw would grow it for future attacks. The player declined to use this pure-upside mana sink.

With the opponent having already lost life this turn from Hired Claw attack triggers, the Hired Claw's +1/+1 counter ability could be activated for {1}{R}. With Steam Vents and Mountain available, pumping one Hired Claw before combat damage would deal an extra 1 damage to the opponent (from 4 total to 5 total). This is a free permanent buff, not just until end of turn.

After combat damage, Haiku Villain has the opportunity to activate Hired Claw's +1/+1 counter ability ({1}{R}: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature, activate only if an opponent lost life this turn). The opponent just took combat damage this turn, so the condition is met. With 3 lands available (Steam Vents, Rockface Village, Mountain), they could activate one Hired Claw's ability for {1}{R}, growing it from 1/2 to 2/3. This is a free advantage that costs no cards and makes future attacks better.

Used Lightning Strike as face burn (3 damage) while opponent has an empty board, spending the only removal spell. With the opponent having lost life this turn, a Hired Claw +1/+1 counter activation would provide permanent board improvement, and holding Lightning Strike preserves crucial removal for incoming threats like Appa or Doc Aurlock.

Playing Floodfarm Verge instead of Temple Garden limits development this turn. Temple Garden (entering untapped for 2 life) would provide {G} alongside Hallowed Fountain's {U}, enabling an immediate Doc Aurlock cast - a key enabler that makes spells from exile cost {2} less, synergizing perfectly with Appa's airbend ability. With Floodfarm Verge, green mana requires paying 1 life from Starting Town anyway, and Doc Aurlock can't be cast this turn.
